blocks.en_text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
blocks.zh_text: 大家好，欢迎来到 Real Easy English，

blocks.en_text: the podcast where we have real conversations in easy English
blocks.zh_text: 这个播客用简单的英语进行真实的对话

blocks.en_text: to help you learn.
blocks.zh_text: 来帮助你学习。

blocks.en_text: I'm Georgie.
blocks.zh_text: 我是 Georgie。

blocks.en_text: And I'm Neil,
blocks.zh_text: 我是 Neil，

blocks.en_text: and don't forget that this podcast is now available as a video on our website,
blocks.zh_text: 别忘了，这个播客现在也可以在我们网站上看视频版，

blocks.en_text: so you can watch us at bbclearningenglish.com.
blocks.zh_text: 所以你可以在 bbclearningenglish.com 上观看我们。

blocks.en_text: Hi Neil, how are you today?
blocks.zh_text: 嗨，Neil，你今天怎么样？

blocks.en_text: Hi, Georgie. I'm very well. Actually,
blocks.zh_text: 嗨，Georgie。我很好。其实，

blocks.en_text: I'm really happy today because the Sun is shining, and it's warm,
blocks.zh_text: 我今天真的很开心，因为太阳出来了，天气很暖和，

blocks.en_text: and it seems like it's been a long time since we had such nice sunny weather.
blocks.zh_text: 而且感觉我们已经很久没有过这么好的晴天了。

blocks.en_text: I know, the changing of the seasons is so wonderful,
blocks.zh_text: 我知道，季节的更替真是太美妙了，

blocks.en_text: and actually, that's what we're talking about today.
blocks.zh_text: 其实，这正是我们今天要聊的话题。

blocks.en_text: Today we're going to talk about the seasons and the different types
blocks.zh_text: 今天我们要聊的是季节，以及英国不同种类的

blocks.en_text: of weather we get in the UK.
blocks.zh_text: 天气。

blocks.en_text: Yes. So in the UK, we – our
blocks.zh_text: 对。所以在英国，我们的

blocks.en_text: seasons are roughly like this.
blocks.zh_text: 季节大致是这样的。

blocks.en_text: So March, April, May – those are the spring seasons.
blocks.zh_text: 三月、四月、五月——这些是春季。

blocks.en_text: Then we move into summer, which is June, July and August. Autumn,
blocks.zh_text: 然后进入夏季，也就是六月、七月和八月。秋季，

blocks.en_text: that's September, October, November.
blocks.zh_text: 就是九月、十月、十一月。

blocks.en_text: And then we're into winter for December, January, February.
blocks.zh_text: 然后就进入冬季，十二月、一月、二月。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. More or less. Approximately.
blocks.zh_text: 对。差不多吧。大致是这样。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. So, Neil, what is your favourite season?
blocks.zh_text: 对。那么，Neil，你最喜欢哪个季节？

blocks.en_text: Well, you can probably guess because I'm so happy
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，你大概能猜到，因为我特别开心

blocks.en_text: that it's spring and summer combined.
blocks.zh_text: 现在正是春夏之交。

blocks.en_text: So anything with long late nights and evenings I love.
blocks.zh_text: 所以只要是白天长、夜晚来得晚的日子，我都喜欢。

blocks.en_text: What else is good about summer?
blocks.zh_text: 夏天还有什么好处？

blocks.en_text: In the summer, you can be outside.
blocks.zh_text: 夏天你可以待在户外。

blocks.en_text: You can go swimming in the sea.
blocks.zh_text: 你可以去海里游泳。

blocks.en_text: You can stay up late and you have wonderful light in the UK.
blocks.zh_text: 你可以熬夜，而且英国的阳光特别好。

blocks.en_text: What's your favourite season then, Georgie?
blocks.zh_text: 那你最喜欢哪个季节呢，Georgie？

blocks.en_text: Well, I'm a big fan of the seasons,
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，我是四季的忠实粉丝，

blocks.en_text: the transition seasons.
blocks.zh_text: 尤其是过渡季节。

blocks.en_text: So I really like spring and autumn, especially spring.
blocks.zh_text: 所以我真的很喜欢春天和秋天，尤其是春天。

blocks.en_text: Right now we're in spring in the UK,
blocks.zh_text: 现在英国正是春天，

blocks.en_text: and you can see everyone looking happier because we've had
blocks.zh_text: 你能看到每个人都显得更开心了，因为我们刚经历了

blocks.en_text: a really long, hard, dark, cold winter and everyone is smiling now
blocks.zh_text: 一个非常漫长、难熬、阴暗又寒冷的冬天，现在每个人都在微笑

blocks.en_text: because they... there are blossoms on the trees which make me so happy.
blocks.zh_text: 因为他们……树上开满了花，这让我特别开心。

blocks.en_text: I love seeing pink blossoms on the trees.
blocks.zh_text: 我喜欢看树上粉色的花。

blocks.en_text: The days are warmer and,
blocks.zh_text: 白天越来越暖和，而且，

blocks.en_text: yeah, there's this sense of a transition.
blocks.zh_text: 对，有一种过渡的感觉。

blocks.en_text: Same with autumn.
blocks.zh_text: 秋天也一样。

blocks.en_text: Although you're leaving the summer months,
blocks.zh_text: 虽然你正在告别夏天的月份，

blocks.en_text: I really love the colours on the trees as well.
blocks.zh_text: 我也真的很喜欢树上那些颜色。

blocks.en_text: Especially those cooler, crisp days when the sky is blue
blocks.zh_text: 尤其是那些更凉爽、清爽的日子，天空湛蓝

blocks.en_text: and the leaves are orange and brown.
blocks.zh_text: 树叶是橙色和棕色的。

blocks.en_text: I love that.
blocks.zh_text: 我很喜欢那样。

blocks.en_text: Wow. You're making me look forward to autumn,
blocks.zh_text: 哇。你让我开始期待秋天了。

blocks.en_text: and it's not even summer yet.
blocks.zh_text: 而且现在还没到夏天呢。

blocks.en_text: Is there a season that you don't like?
blocks.zh_text: 有没有哪个季节是你不喜欢的？

blocks.en_text: I do like all the seasons.
blocks.zh_text: 我其实四个季节都喜欢。

blocks.en_text: I like to have balance, so I wouldn't like to have summer all year round,
blocks.zh_text: 我喜欢有平衡，所以我不希望一年到头都是夏天，

blocks.en_text: but I think winter is my least favourite
blocks.zh_text: 但我觉得冬天是我最不喜欢的季节

blocks.en_text: because of the dark days. In the UK
blocks.zh_text: 因为那些天黑的日子。在英国

blocks.en_text: I think it's particularly hard
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得特别难熬

blocks.en_text: because, especially January and February, it's really cold and
blocks.zh_text: 因为，尤其是一月和二月，真的很冷，而且

blocks.en_text: there's nothing really to get us through the... the sad times.
blocks.zh_text: 真的没有什么能帮我们熬过……那些难过的日子。

blocks.en_text: I know exactly what you mean.
blocks.zh_text: 我完全明白你的意思。

blocks.en_text: There are good things about winter, but mostly it's just difficult, isn't it?
blocks.zh_text: 冬天也有好的地方，但大部分时候就是很难熬，对吧？

blocks.en_text: I agree. It's the dark.
blocks.zh_text: 我同意。就是那种天黑。

blocks.en_text: I can't stand it.
blocks.zh_text: 我实在受不了。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. So, as I said, I quite like having the balance of different seasons
blocks.zh_text: 是啊。所以，就像我说的，我挺喜欢有不同季节的平衡

blocks.en_text: throughout the year.
blocks.zh_text: 一年到头都有变化。

blocks.en_text: I like to have transitions and changes.
blocks.zh_text: 我喜欢有过渡和变化。

blocks.en_text: What about you, Neil?
blocks.zh_text: 你呢，Neil？

blocks.en_text: How do you feel about... about that?
blocks.zh_text: 你对……对这件事怎么看？

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I think I agree.
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，我觉得我同意。

blocks.en_text: I mean, it would be nice to have a shorter winter,
blocks.zh_text: 我是说，冬天短一点会挺好，

blocks.en_text: but I think I would still prefer to have different seasons
blocks.zh_text: 但我觉得我还是更喜欢有不同的季节

blocks.en_text: because, like I said, I really like the late light evenings in the summer.
blocks.zh_text: 因为，就像我说的，我真的很喜欢夏天傍晚天还亮着的感觉。

blocks.en_text: And I think, even though I hate the dark winters,
blocks.zh_text: 而且我觉得，虽然我讨厌天黑得早的冬天，

blocks.en_text: I would really miss that, if the weather was nice all year
blocks.zh_text: 我会很怀念那个的，如果天气一年到头都很好

blocks.en_text: but got dark at the same time, like at six or seven o'clock.
blocks.zh_text: 但天却总在同一时间黑下来，比如六点或七点。

blocks.en_text: OK, let's recap the language we heard in the conversation.
blocks.zh_text: 好，我们来回顾一下对话里听到的语言。

blocks.en_text: We learned different ways to talk about the seasons.
blocks.zh_text: 我们学了谈论季节的不同说法。

blocks.en_text: For example, 'looking forward to' – that means
blocks.zh_text: 比如，'looking forward to'——意思是

blocks.en_text: you're excited for something to happen in the future.
blocks.zh_text: 你对将来要发生的某件事感到兴奋。

blocks.en_text: That's right. So I'm really looking forward
blocks.zh_text: 没错。所以我特别期待

blocks.en_text: to the warm, light, sunny evenings in the summer.
blocks.zh_text: 夏天那些温暖、明亮、阳光充足的傍晚。

blocks.en_text: We heard 'to be a big fan of' – that means that you really like something.
blocks.zh_text: 我们听到了'to be a big fan of'——意思是说你真的很喜欢某样东西。

blocks.en_text: For example, I'm a big fan of spring and autumn.
blocks.zh_text: 比如，我是春天和秋天的超级粉丝。

blocks.en_text: Yes, Georgie is a big fan of the transition seasons.
blocks.zh_text: 是的，Georgie是过渡季节的超级粉丝。

blocks.en_text: I'm not such a big fan of winter, though.
blocks.zh_text: 不过我没那么喜欢冬天。

blocks.en_text: Actually, I can't stand it, which means that I really hate it.
blocks.zh_text: 其实，我实在受不了，意思是我真的很讨厌它。

blocks.en_text: Thanks for listening to Real Easy English.
blocks.zh_text: 感谢收听Real Easy English。

blocks.en_text: We've talked about the seasons in the UK,
blocks.zh_text: 我们聊了英国的季节，

blocks.en_text: but the seasons are different all around the world.
blocks.zh_text: 但世界各地的季节都不一样。

blocks.en_text: What are the seasons like where you live?
blocks.zh_text: 你住的地方季节是什么样的？

blocks.en_text: Email us at learningenglish@bbc.co.uk.
blocks.zh_text: 给我们发邮件到learningenglish@bbc.co.uk。

blocks.en_text: We always like to hear from you.
blocks.zh_text: 我们一直都很想听到你的消息。

blocks.en_text: Goodbye.
blocks.zh_text: 再见。

blocks.en_text: Bye.
blocks.zh_text: 拜拜。
